purpose: Reporting plan for the completed controlled repair analysis.
reporting_rules: Use counts from the completed repair analysis without rerunning a model or validator.
Keep end to end target resolution separate from target status at the last validated graph.
Keep exact clean reference recovery separate from target resolution.
Report no feedback separately from a validated stop.
Treat output failures as trajectory outcomes, not as graph regressions.
Describe bootstrap intervals as resampling sensitivity for the controlled cases, not population performance intervals.
